Create a production-ready raster sprite atlas for VOIDMARCH, a grimdark occult historical strategy game. EXACTLY FOUR separate highly detailed painted tabletop miniatures in a clean evenly spaced 2x2 grid, one complete miniature centered in each quadrant. Each on its own low round dark stone/gravel pedestal, same pedestal construction, isometric three-quarter view from above, facing lower-left. Photoreal hand-painted resin miniature texture with restrained muted palette and readable silhouettes matching high-quality tabletop wargame sprites. TRUE transparent RGBA background everywhere outside each miniature and its small contact shadow, including generous blank margins and wide transparent gutters. No painted checkerboard, no colored backdrop, no terrain scenery, no text, no labels, no border. Keep every weapon, wing, wheel and base entirely inside its quadrant, no crossing gutters. All four subjects comparable visual area. Do not include swastikas, SS insignia, historical extremist symbols or logos.
